study type: Case-control molecular study using single-cell RNA sequencing and spatially resolved transcriptomics
outcome: Differential gene expression (e.g., COL3A1, EGFL6, HGF, DLK1, PECAM1, BMP5, SPP1)
cohort: The study included 12 placentas, comprising 6 placentas with placenta accreta spectrum disorder and 6 control placentas.
finding: Placenta accreta spectrum disorders were characterized by dramatic differences in transcriptional profiles at adherent sites compared to controls and nonadherent sites, primarily driven by alterations in endothelial-stromal populations related to the extracellular matrix, growth factors, and angiogenesis, shifting the etiologic explanation from trophoblast invasion to a loss of decidual boundary limits.
